claims.summary: Free commutator coordinates: over any field, for a generator tuple containing b_u = x_u^2 - x_u and c_uv = x_u x_v - x_v x_u (placeholders Z_u, Y_uv), with x = x_u, y = x_v, xbar = 1 - x, D_1 = x Y_uv x - Z_u y x + x y Z_u and D_0 = xbar Y_uv xbar + Z_u y xbar - xbar y Z_u are placeholder-linear zero-certificates, from the identity x[x,y]x = b_u y x - x y b_u. For old-variable formulas M_1, M_0, D = M_1 D_1 + M_0 D_0 has no clause placeholder, size O(|M_1|+|M_0|+1), and at every Boolean point a (commuting scalars, free placeholders) zero Z- and other commutator coordinates and Y_uv-coordinate M_1(a) x_u(a) + M_0(a)(1 - x_u(a)). Hence for every placeholder-linear certificate C of size S and every pattern g with a formula of size sigma, C + (M - C(x,e_uv))(D_1 + D_0) is a certificate of size O(S + sigma) with the same clause coefficients as polynomials, the same Boolean-generator and other commutator coordinates at every Boolean point, and Y_uv-coordinate g(a) there. For a pair whose commutator is in the tuple, either variable playing x (x_v[x_v,x_u]x_v = -x_v c_uv x_v); several pairs at once at size O(pS + sum sigma), as C + sum_uv (M_uv - C(x,e_uv))(D_1 + D_0)_uv with the original C in every term. Depth of D at most max(depth M_1, depth M_0, 1) + 2 when written distributed. The noncommutative analogue of cor:coefficient-cube-traces fails for commutator coordinates. Composed with lem:matched-jet-envelope in characteristic two, every certificate C of a CNF containing an ordered used list U yields a certificate of size O(|A_t| + |C| + (t+1)(s_U + m) + p(|C_pi| + |A_t|)) with all of an inputs-first image C_pi's Boolean-point coefficient values.
claims.assessment: Working elementary free-algebra identity and its coordinate evaluation, passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections; the shift construction is direct, and the composition with the envelope, the reviewer's correction, was checked by the author against lem:matched-jet-envelope's statement. No lower bound; a method limit for properties of Boolean-point coefficient values.
claims.rationale: Closes the queued item minimum-size-image-coefficients as a restatement in characteristic two: through lem:matched-jet-envelope and lem:boolean-image-values, every inputs-first image's Boolean-point coefficient values are carried by a certificate built from any given certificate at cost polynomial in it and in the refutation.
